original_test_intent: Verify every expected logical network interface exists with correct parent/namespace, MAC, MTU, addressing, VLAN/bond role, operational state and route relationship.
original_method: Pin NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; load expected logical-interface graph across namespaces/VFs/bonds/VLANs with parent adapter/port, MAC, MTU, addresses and state; run exact query read-only; retain raw hierarchy/properties; compare completeness and relationships without changing routes, links or addresses.
manual_activity: Network owner supplies the logical-interface/route manifest and dispositions every missing, extra or mismatched interface.
required_inputs: Expected interfaces by namespace and parent adapter/port
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or modify links, routes, addresses, VLANs or bonds

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a namespace/interface table with parent, MAC, MTU, addressing, VLAN/bond, state and expected routes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Physical adapter/port health does not prove logical configuration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Containers and transient namespaces may create expected ephemeral interfaces; policy must distinguish them.

project_override_considerations: Network design owns management/data namespaces, dynamic addresses/routes and allowable ephemeral interfaces.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and network manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Validates logical-interface relationships and protects management connectivity without modifying network state.
independent_technical_reasoning: Correct physical adapters can coexist with wrong VLAN, bond, namespace or addressing configuration. Logical-interface correctness requires parent/namespace and route relationships, not only a list of names.
